findings.title: Coordinated or alternative objects are silently truncated before the closed-list check
findings.description: and/or may join another target rather than start an irrelevant clause. The second target is discarded, so the apparently exact answer is 149 instead of 131, or a required reminder disappears. The alternative must be unsure. An unsure reminder is accepted for these new constructions.

findings.title: Negation is neither propagated across coordinated negative verbs nor separated from short property clauses
findings.description: Do not delete A or remove B is parsed as deleting B, while not needed so delete B is skipped. Repeated-negation, but-positive, long-property and sentence-boundary controls pass. The issue is action scope, not an unenumerated synonym.

findings.title: Quoted commands longer than 300 characters become executable deletion actions
findings.description: The masking regex ignores a complete paired quote when its text exceeds 300 characters. An explicitly rejected quoted recommendation then adds a definite 149-word warning. The 371-character quoted comment survives normalisation without truncation; short quotes and possessive-apostrophe controls pass.

limits: New ambiguous structures explicitly allow conservative unsure results.
Only established simple syntax requires an exact count.
All cases run normalize_evaluation and production evaluation_text; no browser or real model.
The tests specify the literal advice outcome rather than using helper output as their oracle.
